spans.s:
(I)--a son of दृषद्वती and उशीनर known for his munificence; परीक्षित् compared to him. Knew the yoga power of Hari;
1: भा. I. १२. २०;

. ४५; Va. ९९. २१-23.
father of वृषादर्भ and three other sons (ten sons-म्। प्।); gave up life in service, and attained per- manent fame.
2: भा. IX. २
(II)--a son of चाक्षुष Manu. भा. IV. १३. १६.
(III)--the Indra of the epoch of तामस Manu. Br. II. ३६. ४६; वा. ६२. ४०; Vi.
(V)--a son of माद्री and वृष्णि. M. ४५. 2.
(VII)--a son of Kuru and आग्नेयी. Vi. I. १३. 6.

(II)--a palanquin; reference to that of king सौवीर;
1: Vi. II. १३. ५३.
of Kubera, built by विश्वकर्मा from the वैष्णव effulgence.
2: Ib.
